title: ESI coverage wage limits
description: The wage limits a month for the coverage of an employee by the Employees' State Insurance, ₹21,000 and ₹25,000 for a person with disability, and the rule that an employee whose wages exceed the limit after the beginning of a contribution period stays covered to its end, in the words of rule 50 of the Employees' State Insurance (Central) Rules, 1950, in ESIC's consolidated text, until the Social Security (Central) Rules, 2026 superseded those Rules on 8 May 2026. The Rules of 2026 hold no wage limit, and no wage ceiling for Chapter IV of the Code on Social Security, 2020 under its section 2(89) was found, so the limits end on 7 May 2026: no limit means none is seeded, never that every employee is covered or that none is. From 8 May 2026 the continued coverage is that of S.O. 2351(E), against the ceiling the Central Government may notify. The set answers for the last day of the wage period.

rows.source: Employees' State Insurance (Central) Rules, 1950, rule 50, in ESIC's consolidated text as on 26.04.2024

cells.name: An employee
cells.wording: 50. Wage limit for coverage of an employee under the Act. The wage limit for coverage of an employee under sub-clause (b) of clause (9) of Section 2 of the Act shall be twenty-one thousand rupees a month:

rows.source: Employees' State Insurance (Central) Rules, 1950, rule 50, second proviso, in ESIC's consolidated text as on 26.04.2024

cells.name: An employee who is a person with disability
cells.wording: 50. Wage limit for coverage of an employee under the Act. The wage limit for coverage of an employee under sub-clause (b) of clause (9) of Section 2 of the Act shall be twenty-one thousand rupees a month: Provided further that the wage limit for coverage of an employee who is a person with disability under the Persons with Disabilities (Equal Opportunities Protection of Rights and Full Participation) Act, 1995 (1 of 1996), and under the National Trust for Welfare of Persons with Autism, Cerebral Palsy, Mental Retardation and Multiple Disabilities Act, 1999 (44 of 1999) respectively, shall be twenty-five thousand rupees per month.

rows.source: Employees' State Insurance (Central) Rules, 1950, rule 50, first proviso, in ESIC's consolidated text as on 26.04.2024

cells.name: An employee whose wages exceed the limit after a contribution period begins
cells.wording: 50. Wage limit for coverage of an employee under the Act. The wage limit for coverage of an employee under sub-clause (b) of clause (9) of Section 2 of the Act shall be twenty-one thousand rupees a month: Provided that an employee whose wages (excluding remuneration for overtime work) exceed twenty-one thousand rupees a month at any time after and not before the beginning of the contribution period, shall continue to be an employee until the end of that period.

rows.source: S.O. 2351(E), 8 May 2026, under the first proviso to section 2(26) of the Code on Social Security, 2020

cells.name: An employee whose wages exceed the limit after a contribution period begins
cells.wording: In exercise of the powers conferred by the first proviso to clause (26) of section 2 of the Code on Social Security, 2020 (36 of 2020), the Central Government hereby specifies that an employee whose wages exceed at any time after, and not before, the beginning of the contribution period, the wage ceiling as may be notified by the Central Government under clause (89) of section 2 of the Code for the purposes of becoming a member under Chapter IV of the Code, shall continue to be an employee for the remainder of that contribution period.
